metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene visors in bulk for your next event. Durable, lightweight, and perfect for branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Poly propylene visors offer a lightweight yet durable option for outdoor events, trade shows, and uniform programs. Unlike cotton or foam alternatives, poly propylene resists moisture and holds its shape even in humid conditions, making it a practical choice for golf tournaments, company picnics, or safety crews. These visors accept full-color screen printing or embroidery on the front panel, giving your logo crisp visibility. With a sweatband inside and adjustable closure, they provide all-day comfort for recipients.
heroAltText: Custom poly propylene visors with embroidered logo on front panel, adjustable snapback closure, and moisture-wicking sweatband
